iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.66.66.0/24 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE; iptables -A FORWARD -i awg0 -j ACCEPT; iptables -A FORWARD -o awg0 -j ACCEPT; ip6tables -A FORWARD -i awg0 -j ACCEPT; ip6tables -A FORWARD -o awg0 -j ACCEPT; ip6tables -A FORWARD -i eth1 -o awg0 -j ACCEPT; sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1; sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.eth1.proxy_ndp=1; ip -6 neigh replace proxy 2a00:7c80:0:1d8:a00::2 dev eth1; ip -6 neigh replace proxy 2a00:7c80:0:1d8:a00::3 dev eth1; sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1; iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p tcp -i eth0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.66.66.3:37015; iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p udp -i eth0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.66.66.3:37015; iptables -A FORWARD -d 10.66.66.3 -p tcp -o awg0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j ACCEPT; iptables -A FORWARD -d 10.66.66.3 -p udp -o awg0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j ACCEPT
